title: Warsaw, 24 Dec 1627, to the Bishop of Olmütz? (DECODE R1408, ÖStA HHStA)

steps.what: Figures 12-33 show a monoalphabetic Italian profile; a and m annealed as symbols fall to one vowel, so read as nulls.
5-gram annealing on the numbers alone, six seeds, with and without distinct-core constraint.
5-gram + dictionary coverage annealer converges on one key from random and seeded starts.
Same objective on three shuffled ciphertexts tops out far below the real order.
Converged key is in alphabetical order on odd and even figures, which the annealer could not know.
Letter pairs and rare syllable groups read from all occurrences; word codes glossed from context.

outcome.method_basis: An Italian 5-gram plus dictionary annealer converged on a key that turned out to be in plain alphabetical order on odd and even figures, confirmed against shuffled-ciphertext controls; letter pairs and syllables were then read from context in Tomokiyo's transcription.
outcome.notes: Every spelled word reads; ten word codes and three small groups glossed, not read. Sender and addressee inferred.

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
